Here's the answer DigiLocker allows Aadhaar holders to access their digital documents, but updating personal details such as a registered mobile number or email address requires a separate process through UIDAI. Here's what Aadhaar holders need to know. Anjali Thakur Published 27 Oct 2026, 07:25 PM IST Prefer Livemint on Google Aadhar 2.0 is new way of identification. AI Quick Read Aadhaar holders can access their Aadhaar card in digital format through DigiLocker, but the platform does not provide a facility to change personal details such as a registered mobile number or email address. According to information shared by the government's Digital India campaign , individuals who want to update their Aadhaar details need to visit an Aadhaar enrolment or update centre and follow the prescribed process. DigiLocker is an online platform that allows users to store, access, share and verify documents digitally. Its website lists several documents that users can access through the service, including Aadhaar cards, PAN cards, driving licences and vehicle registration certificates. Also Read | Nitin Gadkari Labels Outrage Over E20 Fuel As ‘Paid Propaganda’ The platform is part of the government's efforts to promote paperless governance. Through its integration with the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), users can access their Aadhaar information after linking their Aadhaar number to their DigiLocker accounts. Also Read | CM Yogi to inaugurate UP projects worth ₹411 crore, GCC summit in Lucknow However, personal information displayed in an Aadhaar-linked profile, including a person's name, address, registered mobile number and email ID, is sourced directly from the UIDAI database. DigiLocker does not provide an option to modify these details. Individuals seeking to update their Aadhaar information must follow the applicable UIDAI process through the designated Aadhaar enrolment or update centres. Also Read | Why investors want lower LTCG tax: How much does the government earn? What are the benefits of DigiLocker? DigiLocker offers several benefits to individuals and government departments by making documents accessible in digital format. Online access to documents Users can access their documents online, reducing the need to carry physical copies. Reduced paperwork The platform helps reduce paperwork in government departments by enabling digital access to documents. Digital document authentication Documents issued by official sources can be digitally verified, making authentication easier. Online self-attestation Users can self-attest documents uploaded to the platform digitally, reducing the need for physical paperwork in applicable processes. She has also worked as Chief Sub-Editor at India.com (Zee Media) and as Senior Correspondent with Exchange4media and Hindustan Times’ HT City, reporting on media, advertising, entertainment, health, lifestyle and popular culture.
